description: The Historical Resource Base Series contains road and access maps created between 1982 and 1997. Six reviewed packages cover National Topographic System blocks 72, 73, 74, 82, 83 and 84. The common source description binds them to one series with roads/highways, railways and railway points, pipelines, trails, major transmission lines, airfields, municipalities, water bodies and natural-resource sites. These are historical infrastructure observations. Maps are available as non-georeferenced PDF files; TIFF copies require contacting the distributor. Individual map dates can differ. No current infrastructure state, numeric positional accuracy or directly usable network topology is established. Geographic coverage is within Alberta. Related map components retain their native catalogue identities. The native packages list Open Government Licence - Alberta and unrestricted access, but isopen is false. Actual file access and any cost are unverified. Distribution metadata mainly points to HTML/XML descriptive pages; these are not machine-readable infrastructure geometries. No map, PDF, image, archive or dataset body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are not stated.
